item.title: Race Industry Week interview: Formula E CEO Jeff Dodds
item.description: Speaking during Race Industry Week, Jeff Dodds, Chief Executive Officer of the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship, shared an ambitious roadmap for the all-electric series as it prepares to enter Season 12 – the final year of the Gen3/Gen3 Evo homologation cycle.

item.title: Ruman to miss Trans Am opener as she continues recovery from accident
item.description: When the 2026 Trans Am Series presented by Pirelli opens March 1 at Sebring International Raceway, a familiar presence in the TA field will be notably absent. After missing the 2025 season finale at Circuit of The Americas in November, Amy Ruman – a Trans Am Hall of Famer and...

item.title: Capps admits ‘I don’t know how I’m going to handle’ splitting NHRA weekend focus with Gordon addition
item.description: As well as handling his own NHRA Funny Car, Ron Capps’ team will be fielding a Top Fuel dragster for rookie Maddi Gordon this season.

item.title: Indianapolis 500 veteran Hucul dies at 79
item.description: Canadian driver Cliff Hucul, a veteran of three Indianapolis 500 starts in the late 1970s, died Feb. 17 on his farm in his native Prince George, B.C.

item.title: F1’s Domenicali urges fans to wait and see how the new cars perform
item.description: Formula 1 President and CEO Stefano Domenicali says the majority of fans will not be able to notice significant differences in driving style required by the 2026 cars and is confident the new regulations will deliver great racing.

item.title: Russell thinks Mercedes needs work to make it four-team fight at the front in Australia
item.description: "We have looked in the mix with several of our rivals near the front but it's clear, with Ferrari topping the times and McLaren and Red Bull Racing being right on their tails, that we need to continue working hard to bring more performance.”

item.title: Chris Gabehart responds to Joe Gibbs Racing lawsuit, denies theft allegations
item.description: Gabehart “forcefully and emphatically” denies the organization's claims that he stole confidential information and trade secrets.

item.title: Schumacher letting the nuances sink in from his first laps on IndyCar ovals
item.description: Mick Schumacher’s first laps around Phoenix Raceway’s legendary one-mile oval were completed with a healthy dose of respect.

item.title: House fire that killed Denny Hamlin's father ruled accidental; exact cause unknown
item.description: A final incident report released by Gaston County Fire Services noted that the heat source and cause of the ignition were undetermined.

item.title: Leclerc brings Ferrari to the fore as Bahrain F1 test concludes
item.description: Charles Leclerc produced the fastest time of pre-season testing and took Ferrari nearly a second clear of the field on the final day in Bahrain.
